scope: Theorem 4.1 (Global prices under the no-win assumption) of the manuscript “Finite tensor savings and exact Fourier circuits” (preprints/Finite-tensor-savings-and-exact-Fourier-circuits-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 130 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e2165b9f6796f018), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a function p : [ n≥1 GLn(C) −→ [0, ∞) which vanishes exactly on the monomial matrices and has the following properties. For invertible matrices of the indicated sizes, p(LAR) = p(A) if L, R are monomial of width |A|, (4.1) p(AB) ≤ p(A) + p(B) if |A| = |B|, (4.2) p(A ⊗ B) = |B|p(A) + |A|p(B), (4.3) p(A ⊕ B) = p(A) + p(B), (4.4) p(A−1 ) = p(AT ) = p(A). (4.5) Moreover, p(U) = 1, U = 1 0 1 1 ! . (4.6)
